name: Sanctuary of Bom Jesus do Congonhas
description: On a hilltop in Congonhas, in Brazil's Minas Gerais state, this 18th-century pilgrimage sanctuary draws visitors up a broad outdoor stairway lined with towering statues of Old Testament prophets. Seven small chapels nearby hold painted figures of the Stations of the Cross, carved by the sculptor Aleijadinho and his assistants. Inside the church, the Italian-inspired Rococo decoration is lavish.
